# Reviewing this marketplace

Use `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` when reviewing pull requests here.
The product is agent instructions and executable tooling: Markdown changes can change
permissions, installation behavior, and hardware operations.

Prioritize concrete correctness, authorization, packaging, and evaluation defects.
Cite the affected location and explain the failure scenario. Avoid stylistic comments
and do not report tests or hardware behavior as verified without execution evidence.
Use `AGENTS.md` for the marketplace contract and scoped instructions where applicable.
